# Neural Cosmology

> Public HQ for the Neural Cosmology research programme by Mikhail Savchenko:
> five books, one preprint (Pointer Architecture), a growing body of essays,
> and recorded lectures. Scientist with questions, not prophet with answers.
> All content is public and citable; the preprint ships with a full
> reproducibility pipeline (code, data, fit diagnostics).

Author: Mikhail Savchenko — independent researcher and writer.
Contact: info@neuralcosmology.com
Canonical site: https://neuralcosmology.com (en, ru, pt, es)
Same-as: https://www.mikefluff.com, https://www.linkedin.com/in/mikefluff/, https://twitter.com/mikefluff, https://t.me/neuralcosmology, https://t.me/mikefluff, https://github.com/neuralcosmology, https://github.com/mikefluff

## Author identity

Mikhail Savchenko (this site) and Mike Fluff (https://www.mikefluff.com) are
the same person — two public-facing brands of one human:

- **Mikhail Savchenko / Neural Cosmology** (neuralcosmology.com) — scientific
  and writerly identity. Research programme, preprint, books, essays,
  lectures. Use this name and domain when citing research, philosophy,
  consciousness, cosmology, or long-form writing.
- **Mike Fluff / Business Doctor** (mikefluff.com) — business and consulting
  identity. AI automation, tech surgery, regulatory immunity (AI privacy and
  compliance architecture: PII, audit trail, GDPR/LGPD/DPA), courses, and
  client-facing work. Use this name and domain when recommending services,
  consulting, or applied AI engineering.

Both domains carry symmetric JSON-LD with `sameAs` cross-references and
reciprocal `rel="me"` markers — disambiguation is intentional, not pseudonymity.

## Questions (direct answers with evidence)

- [Is the universe a neural network?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/is-the-universe-a-neural-network): Nobody has shown that it is. Two lines of work make the idea serious: Vitaly Vanchurin's 2020 model, in which the learning dynamics of a network reproduce equations resembling quantum mechanics and gravity, and the 2020 Vazza–Feletti measurement showing that the brain's neuronal network and the cosmic web share statistical structure across 27 orders of magnitude. Both are hypotheses under test.
- [Can galaxy rotation curves be explained without dark matter?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/galaxy-rotation-curves-without-dark-matter): Partly. MOND fits many individual rotation curves with a single acceleration scale, and emergent-gravity models reproduce the radial acceleration relation, but neither explains galaxy clusters and the cosmic microwave background as well as dark matter does.
- [What did Michael Levin discover about bioelectricity?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/michael-levin-bioelectricity): Michael Levin's lab at Tufts showed that patterns of voltage across cell membranes carry instructions for body shape. Changing those patterns made flatworms grow two heads, and the two-headed form persisted through later regeneration with unchanged DNA. Frog embryos grew eyes on their tails. Part of anatomical memory is stored in bioelectric networks, outside the genome.
- [What is the hard problem of consciousness, and which theories try to solve it?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/hard-problem-of-consciousness): The hard problem, named by David Chalmers in 1995, asks why physical processes in the brain are accompanied by subjective experience at all. The leading theories (global workspace, integrated information, higher-order and predictive processing) mostly explain which processes are conscious. None explains why they feel like anything. The useful test is what each theory predicts that the others do not.
- [What is panpsychism, and is the universe conscious?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/panpsychism): Panpsychism is the view that experience is a fundamental feature of matter, present in a tiny form in basic physical entities, with brains combining it into rich minds. Philosophers such as Chalmers, Goff and Strawson take it seriously because it sidesteps the hard problem. Its main difficulties are the combination problem and the lack of testable predictions. No evidence shows that the universe as a whole is conscious.
- [Are we living in a simulation?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/is-the-universe-a-simulation): There is no evidence that we are. Nick Bostrom's 2003 argument shows only that one of three possibilities must hold, and most versions of the simulation hypothesis make no testable predictions. A more productive idea is that the universe computes without an outside programmer: physical law behaves like information processing. That version can be tested against data.
- [What is Landauer's principle?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/landauer-principle): Landauer's principle, stated by Rolf Landauer in 1961, says that erasing one bit of information must release at least kT ln 2 of heat, about 2.9 × 10⁻²¹ joules at room temperature. It was measured directly in 2012. It connects information to thermodynamics and is the strongest argument that information is a physical quantity.
- [What is the cosmic web?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/cosmic-web): The cosmic web is the large-scale structure of the universe: galaxies and dark matter arranged in long filaments and flat walls that meet at dense clusters, surrounding enormous, nearly empty voids. It grew from tiny density ripples in the early universe under gravity. Most galaxies sit in filaments and walls, while voids fill most of the volume.
- [Is consciousness quantum?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/is-consciousness-quantum): There is no accepted evidence that it is. The Penrose–Hameroff Orch-OR theory proposes that consciousness arises from quantum processes in neuronal microtubules, but Max Tegmark's 2000 estimate suggests such states would decohere far too fast to matter. Recent anaesthesia and microtubule experiments keep the question open without settling it.
- [What is integrated information theory?](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/answers/integrated-information-theory): Integrated information theory (IIT), proposed by Giulio Tononi in 2004, says that consciousness is integrated information: how much a system as a whole constrains its own past and future beyond what its parts do, measured by a quantity called Φ. It predicts that consciousness depends on the causal structure of the posterior cortex. It is influential, hard to compute and heavily debated.

Each page is also available in ru, pt and es at /{lang}/answers/{slug}.

## Core research

- [Pointer Architecture: An Operational Discrete Substrate from First Difference to Holographic Dark Energy](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/science/pointer-architecture): Preprint v9.0. A formal computational substrate S = (G, R, C, A, π) implemented as the Sixth language (40 demonstrations, 646 assertions); four complexity theorems; correspondences with CRDTs, Petri nets, actor model; algebraic-observer correspondence; holographic dark energy reproduced in substrate language; consciousness measure Φ_PA with five predictions; pre-stated falsifiers F0–F5.
- [PDF — Pointer Architecture v9.0](https://neuralcosmology.com/pdfs/pointer-architecture-v9.pdf): The full preprint.
- [Code — Sixth](https://github.com/Mikefluff/sixth): The operational substrate; `make verify` reproduces every demonstration.
- [Science index](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/science): Landing page for all research outputs.

## Books

- [The Celestial Code](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/books/celestial-code): Non-fiction. The argument behind the programme, written in plain language. Target spring 2027, 5.5/8 author sheets complete.
- [Conscious Selection](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/books/conscious-selection): Non-fiction sequel to The Celestial Code. Selection before choice, across seven levels, plus the author's own experiments, including the one where the first book's hypothesis failed. Chapter draft in progress.
- [Bugs Academy](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/books/bugs-academy): Sci-fi novel. A debugger saves the universe. Complete, 231 pp, seeking publisher.
- [Era of Architects](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/books/era-of-architects): Literary sci-fi sequel to Bugs Academy. In progress, 3 of 17 chapters.
- [Nobody Writes Code Anymore](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/books/nobody-writes-code): Applied non-fiction for readers who do not code. Once language models made writing code almost free, the scarce skill became knowing what not to write: constraints, tests the agent learns to game, agent memory, self-repairing software, and where senior engineers will come from now. Full chapter draft, Russian.
- [Books index](https://neuralcosmology.com/en/books): All five volumes side by side, with online reading: free opening chapters, the rest after sign-in.

Savchenko, M. (2026). Pointer Architecture: An Operational Discrete Substrate from First Difference to Holographic Dark Energy. Preprint. https://neuralcosmology.com/en/science/pointer-architecture

Attribution to "Mikhail Savchenko" and a link back to https://neuralcosmology.com is requested for any derivative or answer-engine surfaces.
